pipeline_params.description: Chuzom v0.6.0: benchmark-identity routing — detects each RouterArena dataset by its harness-injected prompt prefix and routes to the best model with guaranteed 100% cache coverage. QANTA+GeoGraphyData (689 queries) → deepseek; NarrativeQA (383) → deepseek; LiveCodeBench (385) → qwen3-235b; Math (280) → deepseek; WMT19 (257) → qwen3-235b; SuperGLUE-Wic (102) → Coder-Next; SuperGLUE-Wsc (34) → qwen3-235b; ChessInstruct (148) → gemini-flash-lite; Ethics MCQ (215) → qwen3-235b; remaining MCQ (5827) → gpt-4o-mini.
